The role requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, cross-border environment.Responsibilities• Acting as a key point of contact for KYC/KYB questions and coordinating responses to requests from banks, vendors, auditors, and customers;• Managing, updating, and maintaining a database of corporate documents to ensure accuracy and completeness;• Managing and overseeing access to the database of corporate documents, including permissions and version control;• Preparing and reviewing, ng corporate documentation;• Finding and implementing efficiencies and process improvements across legal operations workflows;• Identifying and mitigating or escalating legal risks and issues;• Explaining our customer s various business lines to internal business groups and external stakeholders;• Addressing ad hoc requests and projects as they arise.• Prior experience in legal operations, corporate law, compliance, or a related in-house or law firm role;• Familiarity with KYC/KYB and corporate due diligence processes;• Experience reviewing, drafting, and maintaining corporate documents and corporate records;• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage and prioritize multiple requests;• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Spanish and English;• Comfort working independently in a fast-paced, remote, and cross-border environment;• Proficiency with document management systems and standard productivity tools.• While not essential, it will be an asset to be qualified as an Abogado and Notario admitted to practice in El Salvador, with a law degree from a recognized university and current authorization from the Corte Suprema de Justicia.Important information for candidatesRecruitment scams have become increasingly common. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.ioWe will never request payment or financial details. title: Icarus Digital Marketing: Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer
description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://icarusdigitalmarketing.com/ Performance Creative Strategist and AI Producer Remote | Full time | Paid 30-day working trial Icarus Digital Marketing builds and scales direct-response ecommerce brands, including brands in difficult and restricted categories. We are hiring a hands-on performance creative operator to work directly with the owners on our internal portfolio of brands. This is not a conventional graphic-design role. We need someone who understands why Meta ads convert and can personally turn that understanding into high-quality static and video creative using current AI production tools. You may come from dropshipping, affiliate marketing, DTC, a performance agency, or a creative media-buying background. We care more about commercial judgment, production ability, speed, and proof of work than polished credentials. The work You will use and help improve our internal Creative Cockpit. It takes a brand from research and foundational strategy through campaign creation, production, review, and delivery. For each brand, the system holds brand assets and voice, customer language and audience psychology, pains and desires, necessary beliefs, competitor intelligence, awareness levels, angles, hooks, offer context, prior creative, winners, and performance signals. Your job is to turn that intelligence into creative that can sell. • Read campaign briefs, audience research, voice-of-customer material, and brand strategy documents. • Decide what each batch should test and why. • Source and analyse strong visual and structural references. • Develop angles, hooks, scripts, concepts, storyboards, and landing-page direction. • Personally produce static ads and short-form video ads. • Use AI image, video, voice, and editing tools at a high level. • Create meaningful variants without producing repetitive AI slop. • Review work for persuasion, visual quality, brand fit, platform fit, and compliance. • Refine weak generations rather than accepting the first output. • Package approved assets for launch and document what each concept tests. • Read results and use the learning to plan the next batch. What you must be good at • Direct-response advertising and Meta creative strategy • Audience psychology and voice-of-customer interpretation • Awareness levels, hooks, angles, mechanisms, objections, offers, and message-market fit • Understanding when an ad should lead to a PDP, advertorial, listicle, quiz, or sales page • Static ad, UGC, and short-form video production • Visual-reference analysis and controlled recreation • Current AI image and video workflows using tools such as Seedance, Google Flow/Omni, Nano Banana/Gemini, GPT Image, Higgsfield, Kling, Sora, Veo, or comparable tools • Editing, compositing, pacing, captions, sound, and final polish • Fast, organised batch production • Reading creative performance and choosing the next test You are probably not right for this role if • Your portfolio is mostly branding, organic social content, or attractive design without performance context. • You call every asset “scroll-stopping” but cannot explain the audience belief or conversion mechanism. • You are a strategist who depends on other people to make the work. • You are a tool operator who needs someone else to provide every hook, angle, script, and decision. • You use one prompt, accept the first output, and call it AI production. • You cannot show exactly what you personally contributed to portfolio examples. • You dislike volume, iteration, testing, or direct feedback. What success looks like Within 30 days, you can understand our strategy packs and operating system, take a structured brief from research to finished assets with limited supervision, produce a useful weekly mix of static and video concepts, explain the reason for every important decision, maintain quality while moving quickly, and suggest practical improvements to the workflow. Compensation The role begins with a fully paid 30-day working trial at USD $2,000 . If the fit is strong, it becomes a long-term full-time position expected to pay USD $2,000 to $3,000 per month , based on demonstrated level, with additional performance upside available for an exceptional long-term operator. We care about ability, English comprehension, reliability, some overlap with our working hours, and quality of output. How to apply Do not send a generic cover letter. Message Simon on WhatsApp at +353 86 349 5073 and begin with: I make the work. • Send three Meta ads you personally made or materially directed. • For each example, state exactly what you did and explain the audience, angle, hook, and intended next step in the funnel. • Share any useful performance context you are permitted to disclose. Redacted evidence is acceptable. • Show one weak or failed creative and explain what you learned or changed. • List the AI tools you use in real production and explain your normal workflow from reference to finished asset. • Send a Loom of no more than five minutes. Choose one Meta ad you respect, explain why it works, and describe the next three variants you would test. • State your location, timezone, availability, and expected monthly compensation after the trial. Applications without the requested evidence will not be reviewed. Shortlisted candidates will complete a small paid practical exercise before the 30-day trial. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/icarus-digital-marketing-performance-creative-strategist-and-ai-producer

title: Consultant AI & Digital Strategy (m/w/d)
description:
Job Description

Welcome to Nunatak! We are looking for a Consultant AI & Digital Strategy (f/m/d) to join our Munich or Berlin office as soon as possible.

You think in business models and measurable impact, and at the same time you understand what AI can realistically deliver today and what it cannot. That combination is exactly what we are looking for. You advise decision-makers up to C-level on moving AI from pilot projects to genuine value creation: from strategy through the business case to implementation support. For technical depth, our Data & AI Lab works alongside you, together bridging the gap from the strategic question to a working solution.


Responsibilities

As part of our Consulting Team, you will take on the following:

  • Contributing to AI and digital strategies as well as the business models, portfolio and positioning strategies built on them
  • Identifying, prioritizing and assessing AI use cases, including building robust business cases
  • Independently running market, competitor, technology and best-practice analyses as the basis for strategic decisions
  • Supporting implementation together with our Data & AI Lab: you translate between business functions, management and development teams while keeping the tangible benefit in view
  • Contributing to advisory work on the organizational prerequisites for successful AI adoption, such as governance, role models and capability building
  • Preparing and presenting compelling decision papers and making complex topics accessible
  • Owning your own workstreams within our project teams, including coordination with internal and external stakeholders
  • Confident client interaction at both expert and management level, alongside professional communication within the team


Qualifications

What You Bring:

  • A completed university degree (Diplom or Master's) in business administration, economics, industrial engineering, business informatics or a comparable field, with excellent results
  • Relevant internships in a strategy or digital consultancy, in corporate/business development or at a technology-driven company, ideally complemented by initial professional experience or comparable practical exposure
  • Hands-on exposure to AI topics: you have worked on projects with an AI component and can realistically judge what ML, GenAI and agentic systems deliver, and where such initiatives tend to fail in practice
  • A solid understanding of data and technology topics: you speak the language of technical teams without needing to build solutions yourself
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking, combined with an entrepreneurial mindset
  • A genuine consultant and service mindset
  • Drive to deliver, initiative, and strong communication and teamwork skills
  • A confident presence, paired with an independent, results-oriented way of working and a strong willingness to learn
  • Very good MS Office skills
  • Business-fluent command of German and English, both written and spoken


Look forward to:

  • Impact from Day One: A wide range of responsibilities with a high level of ownership and the opportunity to help shape processes, strategies, and products at the management level
  • Culture & Team: A collaborative and supportive work environment in small, interdisciplinary teams with flat hierarchies, short decision-making paths, and a values-driven culture
  • Exciting Environment: Innovative AI-focused projects and clients who are market leaders in their respective industries
  • Growth: Individual opportunities for personal and professional development, along with targeted training and continuing education programs
  • Benefits: Attractive compensation, regular team events (lunches, offsites), BusinessBike, corporate fitness (Wellpass), as well as free drinks, fruit, and snacks in the office
  • Top Locations: A fantastic workplace right next to the English Garden in Munich or close to Alexanderplatz in Berlin
Feel free to visit our Linkedin page to learn more about the team and everyday life at Nunatak.


Contact

Would you like to be part of an interdisciplinary and innovative team? Become a Nunatakeer and join us in our Munich or Berlin office!
We look forward to receiving your application documents (including a cover letter and references). Please also indicate your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date.
For further information or questions, feel free to contact us at We’re excited to hear from you!

title: Tax & Finance Operations Interns (f/m/d) - AI Tax Startup
description:
We are building Germany's leading Tax Advisory firm. Taxforce was founded based on a simple observation: Many business owners want a tax advisor who acts as a true sparring partner: proactive, responsive, and strategic. What they often get instead is a service provider: booking receipts and filing tax returns, with little real advisory.

We’re building the alternative.

Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. We’re starting with healthcare professionals, a complex and underserved segment, with the ambition to expand into many more industries over time.

Instead of pure compliance, we deliver real advisory and become long-term partners to our clients: from initial setup to established organizations.

This is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI is now enabling a fundamental shift and there are no playbooks yet. We’re writing them.

We’re a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company and the former Klarna Head of Engineering. You’ll work directly with the founders, take on real responsibility from day one, and see how AI transforms a real-world industry.

We offer a high-ownership environment, direct feedback and mentoring, a collaborative team, and competitive salary all from our office near Boxhagener Platz.

Join early and help us redefine tax advisory.

Tasks

As a Tax & Finance Intern, you'll work right in the middle of our operational and advisory tax work. You'll take on responsibility from day one, both externally, supporting our tax advisors, and internally, in our own controlling and bookkeeping along the entire value chain: from preparing client tax returns and hands-on research, to managing invoicing, funds, and cashflow, through our monthly internal financial close. Because tech and tax work together at Taxforce, you'll be close to the point where manual work turns into automation and you'll actively help us make our processes better: :

Finance & controlling

  • Take ownership of our invoicing and support funds and cashflow management
  • Support the monthly internal bookkeeping and financial close
  • Build and maintain reporting and controlling analyses over time

Tax Operational work

  • Prepare ongoing financial accounting: receipt capture, booking, account reconciliation
  • Prepare annual financial statement packages and business analyses: Provide simple input on tax returns and pre-filings (income tax, business taxes) at draft level, where you get feedback and develop new skills
  • Support our digital mail and tax assessment processing through deadline control and smart document classification
  • Structured client communication (document requests, follow-ups)
  • Maintain client master data and support deadline contro

Tech & automation

  • Test and document internal tools and workflows
  • Contribute to automating recurring tasks (e.g. document classification, data extraction, integrations)
  • Data preparation and simple analyses

Requirements

  • Drive & ambition: You're excited to work motivated to work in a young team and thrive in fast-paced startup environments.
  • Relevant studies: You're studying business administration, economics, law, tax or a related field, ideally with a focus on or strong interest in tax, accounting or finance
  • First practical experience: You've gained hands-on experience through internships or working student roles (ideally in Tax, Accounting, Finance or Consulting)
  • Care & accuracy: You work carefully and precisely, because in tax and finance every detail counts
  • Structured & independent: You organise yourself well, prioritise between tasks and get things done without needing everything spelled out
  • Tech-savvy: You're comfortable using AI tools and can implement small automations yourself and you have no problem with learning new tools and skills on the go
  • Collaborative: You are a team player. Working together as a team and sharing knowledge comes naturally to you
  • German language skills: We are a fast growing start-up with a diverse team. However, our customers do mostly speak German. Hence we require German language skills.

Benefits

  • Learn from an experienced team: Work closely with founders and tax advisors and get direct feedback and mentoring from day one
  • Ownership from day one: Take on real responsibility early and help shape how Taxforce is built across tax, finance, and operations
  • Front-row seat to AI in the real world: See how AI is applied to transform a traditional industry and actively contribute to building an AI-driven product
  • Steep learning curve: Work on real clients and real numbers, not example cases, and build skills that carry into your career
  • Strong team environment: Join an ambitious, supportive team with direct feedback and a high level of trust and ownership
  • Fair working student salary and a great office: Competitive pay and flexible hours around your studies, from our office near Boxhagener Platz

Office Policy: We work 5 days in the office, because we feel that is crucial to enable speed, learning, and compounding interests when working next to each other.

We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold. Job Summary: As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal, you will be a key driver of growth within our AI Solutions business. In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise clients by helping them solve complex business challenges through forward-deployed AI solutions, AI software and platforms, AI services, and AI-enabled transformation. You will develop tailored solutions that help clients move from AI strategy and experimentation into production, combining Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to achieve measurable business outcomes. This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and establish Toptal as a core AI services provider embedded in your clients’ most critical initiatives. Companies are investing in models, agents, AI platforms, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled applications, but many are struggling to translate those investments into production systems and measurable business outcomes. The challenge is no longer simply selecting an AI model or platform. Enterprises must identify the right workflows, connect AI to their proprietary data and knowledge, integrate existing systems, build and deploy agents and applications, establish evaluation and control frameworks, drive adoption, and continuously operate and improve AI in production. Responsibilities: *The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units, workflows, technology platforms, and senior executive relationships. These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, understanding the client’s AI and technology environment, aligning solutions to evolving business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level. Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account while consistently driving measurable client value and long-term growth. • Own and build a portfolio of enterprise AI accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes. • Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish. • Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning. • Lead AI solution development and deal execution in partnership with AI Services leadership, Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, Partnerships, and Delivery teams. • Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature. • Shape AI solutions that apply Toptal’s capabilities across AI Strategy & Transformation, Agentic Solutions, Data Services, AI Platforms, Industry Solutions, Joint Partner Solutions, and Managed Services to clients’ most important business and operating challenges. • Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making. • Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment. In the first week, expect to: • Onboard with Toptal and meet your TopPal. • Learn the core of Toptal’s model, our value proposition, and our deep capabilities. • Familiarize yourself with the tools and resources needed to be successful. • Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks. • Become familiar with our contracting and legal methodologies, templates, tools, and processes. You'll carry a book of 120+ accounts with roughly $2M in ARR, and your job is to make sure those customers are engaged, getting value, and set up for renewal. This is an entry-level role with real ownership from day one, and you'll have mentorship from senior teammates as you ramp into the commercial side of the work. What You'll Do • Own the day-to-day relationship for your book of accounts, serving as the primary point of contact and keeping customers informed, engaged, and successful on the platform • Contribute ideas to dashboards and workflows to track your book of business - renewal timelines, health signals, engagement levels, and expansion indicators - so nothing falls through the cracks • With guidance of leadership, drive outreach to customers ahead of renewal, lead those conversations, handle objections, and negotiate terms on flat renewals and smaller expansions, looping in Sales when a meaningful expansion opportunity emerges. • Track and forecast your renewal book on a rolling basis, proactively surfacing risks and creating plans to address them before they become problems • Use product usage data and customer outcomes to demonstrate value in renewal conversations and ongoing check-ins • Identify opportunities for feature adoption and product expansion within accounts, and flag those signals to the Sales team to build expansion pipeline • Gather and synthesize customer feedback and share it with Product and internal stakeholders to inform roadmap decisions and improve the customer experience • Work closely with senior CS teammates and your manager to develop your skills in account management, commercial negotiation, and customer communication What You'll Bring • Some experience in a customer-facing role - title: Associate, Talent Operations
description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

Role Summary

We are seeking an exceptionally organized, tech-forward Talent Operations Associate to join our Global Talent Acquisition team. As our Talent Operations Associate in London, you will bridge the gap between ensuring our recruiters, and interviewer community are able to find the best talent, through cutting-edge Talent Operations.

We are seeking a proactive AI and automation expert to transform our hiring operations. In this role, you will leverage emerging tools to streamline scheduling, resolve logistics challenges, and build data-driven dashboards. If you thrive on solving complex problems, engaging consultatively with senior stakeholders, and redefining talent operations, we want to hear from you.

Key Responsibilities

  • TA Ops projects: manage process improvement projects to move the business forward as needed.

  • AI, automation & workflow optimisation: use AI tools and automation to remove manual bottlenecks, hunt for friction points in daily operations, and redesign workflows toward an admin-zero environment.

  • Ashby / ATS ownership: own and configure Ashby within agreed standards and controls, testing new features and AI integrations to improve pipeline velocity.

  • Contract configuration: configure the contracts for your region and update them as Legal and the People team make changes in Ashby, and build addendums (e.g. start date) that can live in Ashby.

  • Support the recruiters in your region with Ashby and workflow optimisation: optimise interview plans, set up automations, make sure comms are correct, and unblock recruiter issues as they arise.

  • Stakeholder management & interviewer enablement: partner with departments on interviewer training requests and shadowing programmes, train up new bar raisers, and use performance data to analyse interviewer effectiveness and improve training across the interviewer community.

  • Vendor support: partner with key vendors such as HireRight and Cappfinity, managing the day-to-day relationship and helping move the partnership forward.

  • Process documentation: write SOPs and policies for TA and keep the knowledge base up to date as things move forward.

  • Data requests & reporting: handle regional and departmental data requests, and produce reports and dashboards that make your area better.

  • Data quality: perform regular data-quality checks to keep reporting accurate and reliable.

  • Support the coordinators in your region: act as the local operational support and escalation point for the coordinators in your hub.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in high-volume, multi-region/country talent operations, or a similar recruitment support function.

  • Proactive Problem-Solving: A resourceful, solution-oriented mindset able to resolve high-friction scheduling logistics while simultaneously troubleshooting broader operational challenges across the hiring lifecycle.

  • AI & Automation Proficiency: Proven experience or a demonstrated passion for using AI tools, prompt engineering, or workflow automations to solve operational inefficiencies.

  • Data Fluency: Demonstrated ability to work with hiring data and build reporting dashboards to identify bottlenecks and guide decisions.

  • Strong Executive Presence: Confident, tactful communication skills with the ability to manage senior stakeholders and hold them accountable to timeline commitments.

  • Tech-Savvy: Hands-on experience with modern Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) to manage candidate pipelines.

  • Strong Project Management: Ability to prioritize, organize and manage multiple projects in various stages with ease.

Preferred Experience

  • Direct experience with Ashby (ATS).

  • Hands-on experience building custom dashboards or using business intelligence tools.

  • Background in a high-growth technology, AI, or Fintech environment.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

title: Account Operations & Farming Specialist
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Account Operations & Farming Specialist based in Switzerland.

This role sits at the intersection of IT Operations, account infrastructure, and media buying support in a fast-growing international environment. You’ll take ownership of account access, lifecycle management, subscriptions, and operational processes while supporting Media Buying teams. A key part of the position is building and developing Meta account farming infrastructure and ensuring accounts are prepared for effective use. You’ll work with suppliers, proxies, browser profiles, email, phone numbers, 2FA, verification, and recovery processes. The role also involves identifying account-quality issues, analyzing losses and blocks, and improving processes through automation. It’s a strong opportunity for a systematic and proactive specialist who enjoys solving operational challenges and building scalable infrastructure.


Accountabilities:
  • Manage employee access, including account provisioning, access maintenance, onboarding, and offboarding processes.
  • Manage user accounts, services, internal tools, subscriptions, licenses, and related operational resources.
  • Provide IT Operations support to Media Buying teams, ensuring they have the accounts, tools, and infrastructure required to work effectively.
  • Maintain accurate records, documentation, account inventories, and current operational statuses.
  • Build, manage, and continuously improve Meta account farming and account infrastructure processes.
  • Prepare advertising accounts and related resources for Media Buying teams.
  • Manage suppliers and account resources, including proxies, email addresses, phone numbers, 2FA, browser profiles, and recovery data.
  • Handle account checkpoints, verification, recovery, and related troubleshooting processes.
  • Monitor account quality and analyze the causes of account losses, restrictions, or blocks.
  • Collaborate with Farm teams to share knowledge, adopt relevant expertise, and improve operational practices.
  • Identify repetitive or inefficient processes and define requirements for automation.
  • Contribute to a structured, scalable, and well-documented account operations environment.

    • Requirements:

  • Hands-on experience with Meta farming and/or advertising account infrastructure.
  • Solid understanding of the advertising account lifecycle, from setup and preparation through ongoing management and recovery.
  • Practical experience handling checkpoints, verification, and account recovery.
  • Experience working with proxies, anti-detect or browser-profile solutions, email accounts, phone numbers, and 2FA.
  • Experience managing suppliers or other account-related resources.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently investigate issues and propose practical solutions.
